### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **2** package(s): `@objectstack/lint`, `@objectstack/spec`, touching **69** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **16** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/api-surface/ai.json`, `packages/spec/api-surface/ui.json`, `packages/spec/authorable-surface/ai.json`, …), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**24** hand-written doc(s) name something this change touched — list omitted above 15 rows. Re-derive on the tree named below: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json d4a843911d50eb06ef045adc4035c9f6641f85c7`.

⛔ **13** release-owned page(s) also affected — read-only, see AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **16** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/api-surface/ai.json`, `packages/spec/api-surface/ui.json`, `packages/spec/authorable-surface/ai.json`, …) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **18** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **65** of **231** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **166** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **166**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **107** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **171** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json d4a843911d50eb06ef045adc4035c9f6641f85c7` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `afefc6730936d838f896772834569bcc4163386c` — the merge of head `63a9011154df04382138bdc4f003f59ae55cbd59` into base `d4a843911d50eb06ef045adc4035c9f6641f85c7`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin afefc6730936d838f896772834569bcc4163386c && git checkout afefc6730936d838f896772834569bcc4163386c
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin d4a843911d50eb06ef045adc4035c9f6641f85c7 63a9011154df04382138bdc4f003f59ae55cbd59 && git checkout -B drift-repro d4a843911d50eb06ef045adc4035c9f6641f85c7 && git merge --no-ff 63a9011154df04382138bdc4f003f59ae55cbd59

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json d4a843911d50eb06ef045adc4035c9f6641f85c7
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs d4a843911d50eb06ef045adc4035c9f6641f85c7` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `63a9011154df04382138bdc4f003f59ae55cbd59`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/ai/dataset-tools.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/ai/index.ts, packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts, packages/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/ui/dataset.zod.ts, docs/adr/0149-ai-answers-business-questions-through-the-dataset-semantic-layer.md + packages/lint/src/i18n-walk.ts (the scaffold producer of the new translation key), packages/spec/liveness/dataset.json and packages/spec/liveness/state-counts/dataset.md (the D6 reader rows), packages/spec/liveness/translation.json (the resolver anchors), .changeset/31587-dataset-vocabulary-tool-schemas.md (②). Read, not reviewed: packages/spec/src/api/analytics.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/shared/strict-object.ts, packages/spec/src/shared/lazy-schema.ts, packages/spec/src/ui/i18n.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/data/analytics.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/data/query.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/contracts/ai-service.ts, packages/services/service-analytics/src/dataset-compiler.ts, packages/mcp/src/mcp-http-tools.ts, packages/rest/src/analytics-routes.ts, packages/spec/liveness/analytics_cube.json. The rest of the diff (tests, generated manifests and references, api-surface / export-origins / declaration-map, dropped-refinements and isomorphism-pin ledgers, llms.txt, strictness-ledger counts) is the lane seat's ACCEPT at TIER_DEFAULT.

Inputs: card #31587 body and its five comments (triage 6724017037, claim 6724342469, amends 6724438166 and 6725302604, dev report 6725998087); PR #31652 body, 36-file list and the net diff against `main` (merge-base c5361e2c); the 69 check-runs on the head: 58 `success`, 11 `skipped` (opt-in and conditional jobs), 0 `failure` — Lint · PM dispatch-gates, Spec property liveness, Type Check UI, Governed Surface Queue Guard, Check Changeset and the Test Core / Test UI shards all green. The dev report was taken on `e592f03c`; the head under review adds one commit renaming the three catalogue schemas (`DatasetToolCatalog*`) after `check:spec-symbols`, and the check-runs above are the head's own.

### ① Derived judgments

Accept-set, authoring surface (`ui/dataset.zod.ts`):
- `DatasetDimensionSchema` and `DatasetMeasureSchema` accept `synonyms` (`DatasetMemberSynonymsSchema`: each `/^\S(?:.*\S)?$/u`, max 60, max 20 per member) and `description` (`I18nLabelSchema` by reference) — **right**, ADR-0149 D1's two keys, M1 ruled A.
- The two `guidance.description` prescriptions are removed, so a member `description` that was refused now parses — **right**, the retirement D1 and M1 assign to card 1; widening only.
- Eleven aliases (`synonym`, `alias`, `aliases`, `alternateNames`, `terms`, `keywords` → `synonyms`; `aiDescription`, `aiContext`, `hint`, `help`, `tooltip` → `description`) are the exact D1 list; an alias only re-points a refusal, so the accept set does not move — **right**. No key of either spread collides with an existing alias or declared key (checked both maps on the head).
- `DatasetSchema.superRefine` gains `checkDatasetVocabulary`: refuses a synonym repeated on one member, a synonym equal to another member's `name`, `label` (each locale of an inline map) or synonym, dimensions and measures as one population, and a member `description` over 500 characters per locale; a synonym equal to its own name or label is accepted as written; two datasets are independent — **right**, D1's validation paragraph clause by clause. Every new refusal reaches only documents carrying the new keys, so every dataset that parsed on `main` parses to the same value.
- `normalizeDatasetTerm` (NFKC → lower case → `_`/`-` to space → whitespace collapsed → trim) is exported from `ui` — **right**: D3 rule 1 and D2 require the matcher and the validation to share one function; `ui.json` api-surface gains it with `DatasetMemberSynonymsSchema` / `DatasetMemberSynonyms`.

Accept-set, translation group (`system/translation.zod.ts`, `system/i18n-resolver.ts`, `lint/src/i18n-walk.ts`):
- `datasets.*.dimensions.*.description` and `datasets.*.measures.*.description` are declared and overlaid by `translateDatasetMembers` through `lookupDatasetMemberAttr` under the same `valueOverridesPackagedBase` rule as `label`; the array reference is kept when neither attribute matched — **right**, D1's i18n stance ("member descriptions ARE display text, like labels").
- `DATASET_MEMBER_NO_DESCRIPTION` (module-private) is retired and `guidance.synonyms` (`DATASET_MEMBER_SYNONYMS_NOT_TRANSLATED`) added on both member translation shapes — **right**, D1 asks for exactly that entry; `synonyms` in a bundle was refused before (unknown key) and is refused now with the reason, so no narrowing.
- `walkDatasets` emits the member `description` key with `pushOptional` (recorded even when unauthored, scaffolded only from inline text) and nothing for `synonyms` — **right**; the `@objectstack/cli` coverage test flips ride on it.
- `liveness/translation.json` re-anchors the datasets row and its three children on `lookupDatasetMemberAttr` — **right**, the old symbol is gone.

Public surface, `ai` (`ai/dataset-tools.zod.ts`, `ai/index.ts`; 24 new api-surface rows, 10 new JSON Schema manifest rows):
- `ListDatasetsInputSchema` strict, `terms?: string[]` (each non-empty), aliases `query`/`q`/`keywords`/`search` → `terms` — **right** (D2).
- `QueryDatasetInputSchema` strict, `datasetName: string.min(1)`, `selection: DatasetSelectionSchema` by identity (the test pins `toBe`), aliases `dataset`/`name` → `datasetName`, guidance for `cube` and `previewDrafts`, one `guidanceSets` prescription for a selection member written at top level — **right**: D2's "no inline `dataset`, no `previewDrafts`", the selection's own aliases and guidance apply inside; the REST door (`analytics-routes.ts`) takes the same `selection` key.
- Catalogue: `DatasetToolCatalogEntrySchema { name, label, description?, object, membersWithheld?: literal(true), dimensions, measures, matches? }`, dimension `{ name, label, description?, type: DimensionType, synonyms? }`, measure `{ name, label, description?, aggregate?: AggregationFunction, format?, polarity?: DatasetMeasurePolarity, synonyms? }`, `DatasetTermMatchSchema { term, member: /^(dimensions|measures)\.[a-z][a-z0-9_]*$/, matchedOn: name|label|synonym }`, output `{ datasets, partial?: literal(true), warning? }` — **right** against D2's sketch. Two measured departures, both stated in the PR's acceptance notes and both correct against the cited code: `aggregate` optional because `DatasetMeasureSchema.aggregate` is optional on a derived measure; `type` is `DimensionType` (`time`, not `date`), the word `dataset-compiler.ts#dimensionType` emits (`date → time`, `lookup → string`, default `string`) and the word `AnalyticsResultResponseSchema` says `fields[].type` carries.
- The `Tool` infix on the three catalogue names departs from the PR's first head, not from the ADR (which names no schema): `@object-ui/app-shell` already exports `DatasetCatalogEntry` and ui's `check:spec-symbols` refused the collision — **right**.
- `DatasetProvenanceSchema { kind: 'dataset', dataset { name, label }, measures [{ name, label, description? }], dimensions [{ name, label }], runtimeFilter?: FilterConditionSchema }` — **right**, D2's block verbatim; `runtimeFilter` is the same `FilterConditionSchema` the selection's `runtimeFilter` carries, and the dataset's own `filter` has no slot, as D2 requires.
- `QueryDatasetOutputSchema = AnalyticsResultResponseSchema.shape.data.omit({ sql }).extend({ provenance, rowCount, truncated, delegationNarrowed?: literal(true), warning? })` — **right**: D2's "the `AnalyticsResult` … drill sidecars as they are, plus provenance, rowCount, truncated"; no SQL (ADR-0021); the narrowing pair is byte-for-byte `mcp-http-tools.ts#withDelegationNotice`'s `{ delegationNarrowed: true as const, warning }`, and `partial: true` is `list_objects`' literal (line 1864), so the "#6504 shape" claim holds.
- `getDatasetToolJsonSchemas()` memoized, `io: 'input'` for `parameters`, `io: 'output'` for `outputSchema`, each a plain record of string to unknown — **right** against `AIToolDefinition.parameters` / `.outputSchema`.
- `dropped-refinements.baseline.json` gains three `FilterCondition` lazy sites under the new `ai/*` schemas (257 / 1035) — **right**, the lazy filter is the one construct the projection cannot carry, and no refinement was weakened.

D6 ledger (`liveness/dataset.json`, state counts 2 → 6 planned): four rows, each `planned`, each naming the spec's validation as what judges today, `translateDatasetMembers` as what carries `description`, and #31589 (term matcher, `compileDataset` → Cube member `description` → `getMeta`, `list_datasets` catalogue) as the reader, with the `overrides` row as precedent — **right**, D6's table row for row.

ADR hunk (line 37): the `#DATASET_MEMBER_NO_DESCRIPTION` symbol anchor becomes a file link with the constant in plain backticks and "(retired by M1 (ruled A))" — **right**: `check:adr-symbol-anchors` would otherwise name a symbol this head removes, and no decision text moves.

### ② Semver level

`.changeset/31587-dataset-vocabulary-tool-schemas.md`: `@objectstack/spec: minor`, `@objectstack/lint: minor` — **matches** what the diff publishes: new optional keys, new translation keys, a new `ai` module with 24 exports and three new `ui` exports (spec); a new emitted i18n key in the extract walk (lint). `@objectstack/cli` changes are test-only and carry no changeset, correctly. Nothing that parsed on `main` is refused on this head (measured above), so `Clause-②: yes (widening)` on the PR body and in the changeset is the right line, and `Metadata-protocol: added` is right for two new authorable keys and a new protocol module. Check Changeset is green on the head.

### ③ Boundary flags

The PR carries no `open_questions` block. Every dev flag answered:
- Out-of-surface files (cli coverage test, metadata-form reconciliation `omit` rows, the ADR anchor, llms.txt): each seat-approved in claim amends 1 and 2 — **closed**.
- "No `ui/` or `platform-objects` mirror of the dataset translation group exists": **confirmed** on the head — `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/metadataError.ts#DATASET_MEMBER_INPUT_KEYS` is the Studio designer's per-key labels (Studio authoring is #31660 under fork 5 = A), and `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/en.ts` is a bundle, not a schema mirror.
- `aggregate` optional vs the ADR sketch: **answered**, right against `DatasetMeasureSchema`.
- Nine isomorphism pins, not eleven; three new dropped-refinement sites; the container heap trap; `test:repo` in chunks: ledger and environment notes, nothing for the contract — **closed**.
- `analytics_cube.json` member-description notes stay until card 2 (claim amend 1): **accepted deviation**, carried as nit 2 below so the card 2 PR flips them.
- Tier H: the `docs/adr/**` hunk puts the PR under the governed-approver gate; this record is the contract review the claim owes and is not that approval. Human Minimum item 8 is unchecked for the lane-required Chinese block, as the body says.
- Follow-ups named on the PR body (`Skills-docs: follow-up #31659`, Studio authoring #31660) are stated, not verified here (outside this review's inputs).

### ④ Design judgment

Each `hits` file against the ADR it implements and its first consumer, and each implementing file against the contract sentence by sentence; the cited code read on the head.

- `ui/dataset.zod.ts` — holds. Tried to break `checkDatasetVocabulary`: a synonym that normalizes to the empty string (`"_"`) passes the regex and is skipped by `index`, so it collides with nothing and matches nothing (harmless); a synonym-to-synonym collision is reported exactly once, on the later member (a target owned by a later member is skipped), and a within-member repeat is excluded from the cross-member pass; a member whose `synonyms` or `description` fails its own type parse aborts the payload before the refinement runs, so the refinement never sees a non-string. Every message names both members and the word, as D1 requires for the `DATASET_INVALID` envelope.
- `ai/dataset-tools.zod.ts` and `ai/index.ts` — hold against D2, `DatasetSelectionSchema`, `AnalyticsResultResponseSchema`, `AIToolDefinition`, the compiler's type words and the MCP narrowing/partial precedents (all read, cited in ①). The by-reference `selection` and `data` members mean a door change reaches the tool without a second edit, which is the ADR's reason for declaring the shapes in spec.
- `system/translation.zod.ts`, `system/i18n-resolver.ts`, `lint/src/i18n-walk.ts` — hold against D1's i18n stance; the overlay, the key face and the scaffold producer agree with one another (label and description handled identically; synonyms nowhere).
- ADR-0149 hunk — holds against its first consumer (this PR) and its execution plan (D7: card 4 folded into card 1, as D7 allows; D6 rows `planned`).

Findings:

1. **nit** — `ui/dataset.zod.ts`: the member `description` bound (≤ 500 per locale) is judged only in `DatasetSchema`'s refinement, while the member schemas' own `.describe()` text states the bound and `synonyms`' bounds sit on the member. A dimension or measure parsed on its own accepts a longer text. No production path parses a member alone (no non-test `DatasetDimensionSchema` / `DatasetMeasureSchema` parse on the head), the jsdoc says where the bound is judged, and the test pins it; the ADR fixes no level for this bound. Accepted deviation, or a follow-up if a standalone member door ever appears.
2. **nit** — `packages/spec/liveness/analytics_cube.json` (not in the diff; read): the measures and dimensions `description` notes still say the dataset schema "refuses it and points to the dataset's own `description`", which is false from this head. The seat ruled the notes stay until card 2 (claim amend 1); the card 2 PR that lands the compiler write must rewrite both notes when it flips the dataset rows to `live`.
3. **nit** — `ai/dataset-tools.zod.ts`: `cube` written inside `selection` receives `DatasetSelectionSchema`'s own guidance, which names `dataset` (an inline definition) as a legal address one level up; on this tool `dataset` is an alias to `datasetName`, so the author arrives at `datasetName` after a second refusal. Stated in acceptance note 9; the message belongs to the REST door's schema and is not this PR's to change. Accepted.
4. **nit** — `normalizeDatasetTerm` lower-cases where D1/D3 say "case-fold" (differs only for ß / dotted-İ class characters). Both the validation and the future matcher call the one function, so matching stays self-consistent. Accepted.

No must-fix, no should-fix. The nits need no change on this head.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：数据集的维度和指标可以写业务同义词（`synonyms`，如「营收」→ 收入、销售额）和一两句业务定义（`description`，不是给 AI 的提示词）；同一数据集里一个词只能指向一个成员。spec 里还新定义了 AI 用的两个工具 `list_datasets` / `query_dataset` 的输入、输出和「数据来源」块。
- 为什么改：ADR-0149 已裁定 AI 通过数据集口径回答业务问题。没有同义词，AI 认不出问题里的词指哪个指标；没有定义和来源块，AI 说不清一个数字算了什么。
- 风险与回滚：只放宽不收紧，main 上能通过的数据集和翻译包照常通过、结果不变。新键现在只做校验和翻译，真正读它们的是后续卡 #31589，在那之前不改变任何答案。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/spec/src/ui/dataset.zod.ts`（两个新键和同义词唯一性校验），再看 `packages/spec/src/ai/dataset-tools.zod.ts`（两个工具的契约）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/ui/dataset-member-vocabulary.test.ts src/ai/dataset-tools.test.ts` 全绿。
- 需要你做的：批准本 PR（Tier H，因改了 `docs/adr/0149` 的一处锚点链接）；批准后由本席落地。契约复核 PASS 在案：评论 6726641120，`Head-sha: 63a9011154df04382138bdc4f003f59ae55cbd59`。
- 席位意见：建议合。CI 全绿，契约复核只有 4 条 nit、无须改动；分支落后 main 9 个提交，`git merge-tree` 无冲突，合并队列会在最新 main 上重建验证，所以不为合 main 移动已复核的 head。

## 席位核对 · ACCEPT · 2026-11-08T20:24Z · head `63a9011154df04382138bdc4f003f59ae55cbd59`

Seat `domain:spec#2` reviewed the diff of its own dispatch (claim 6724342469 on #31587, amends 6724438166 / 6725302604, card thread `session_01QsR2jRiQkMaCYPfDtsAcVP`, report 6725998087). Checked against GitHub, not against the report.

1. **Shape:** 36 files, +1809 / -111 (1920 lines, under the 3000 threshold). Draft, base `main`, body opens `Fixes #31587`. Source: `ui/dataset.zod.ts`, new `ai/dataset-tools.zod.ts` + `ai/index.ts`, `system/translation.zod.ts`, `system/i18n-resolver.ts`, `lint/src/i18n-walk.ts`; tests; liveness rows; regenerated manifests, surfaces and `content/docs/references/**`; one changeset (`@objectstack/spec` minor, `@objectstack/lint` minor). Every file is inside the claim as amended. No `content/docs/releases/` change.
2. **Premise:** held at claim time (95df3459) and on this head: the keys, the translation keys and the tool module did not exist on `main`; `DATASET_MEMBER_NO_DESCRIPTION` and both `guidance.description` entries are retired as M1 (ruled A) says.
3. **Gates / check-runs:** on this head 69 runs, 59 success, 10 skipped, 0 red. `check-expected-skips --pr 31652`: OK, every skip in main's roster (exit 0). Dev: `dispatch-gates --ran` 117/117 on `e592f03c`; patch round 1 (`e592f03c` → `63a90111`) renamed the three catalogue schemas to `DatasetToolCatalog*` after Type Check UI's `check:spec-symbols` refused a collision with `@object-ui/app-shell`'s own `DatasetCatalogEntry`, and CI is green on the new head. Consumer packages read by the dev: lint, cli i18n, service-analytics, metadata-protocol, platform-objects, all green.
4. **Accepted deviations:** the contract review's four nits stand as accepted: the member `description` 500-character bound is judged at dataset level only; `analytics_cube.json` member-description notes stay until #31589 (carry note posted there); `cube` inside `selection` takes the selection schema's own guidance; `normalizeDatasetTerm` lower-cases rather than full case-folds. Catalogue `aggregate` optional and dimension `type` = `DimensionType` depart from the ADR sketch and are right against the cited code (review ①). The dev's suggestion to label the PR `needs-user-decision` is not taken: that label lives on decision cards, never on a PR; the PR waits under `pm:awaiting-merge`.
5. **Out of scope / Skills-docs:** `Skills-docs: follow-up #31659` (the `domain:skills` child); Studio form authoring of both keys is #31660, which removes the four reconciliation `omit` rows. Both are `Blocked-by: #31587` and knocked to triage (6726287767). Readers per D6: #31589 (service-analytics), then #31590 (MCP).
6. **Landing:** `check-governed-merges --pr 31652`: governed, Tier H (`docs/adr/**` ×1). `Clause-②: yes (widening)`, `Metadata-protocol: added`. Contract review at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`: PASS, record 6726641120 on this head (an isolated Fable reviewer adopted by this seat, under the maintainer's 2026-11-08 16:12Z rule that a lane runs its own review while the director is off). The maintainer merges by hand, or an authorized approval (`GOVERNED_APPROVERS`) and then this seat lands it (ready, auto-merge). On merge: `Fixes` closes #31587; this seat posts the landing note and lifts the `Blocked-by: #31587` cards.
